title: Screenshot pipeline for App Store submission
acceptance: One command produces App Store screenshots for the required device sizes
Shots cover the library, an article in full screen, search with a highlighted snippet, and highlights or markup
Output lands in a gitignored directory, named so the device size and order are obvious at upload time
The run seeds its own content and needs no manual setup
Screenshots are regenerated, not hand-edited: re-running replaces them
notes: The UI suite already navigates library to reader to highlights and calls XCTAttachment on both device classes, so most of this exists - the job is turning attachments into named files at the right sizes rather than writing new navigation. Apple currently requires 6.9-inch iPhone and 13-inch iPad shots; other sizes are derived. Note T-0005 found the suite needs a signed local build because CloudKit traps under CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, so the script must not force signing off. Output is gitignored: screenshots are build artefacts, not source, and a 5MB PNG in git history is permanent.
